score_description: For every valid symbol, compute the opposite-funding-crowd direction and the minimum of crowding-threshold margin and aligned-price-confirmation-threshold margin. Add the frozen 2.0 pass-boundary offset, apply the desired direction as the sign, and capture that final finite signed long-desirability dict once. Magnitude at least 2.0 passes both component thresholds; larger magnitude ranks higher. The exact returned dict drives filtering, side selection, ordering, and capped proportional weights.
